digest.component_or_area: verifier model resolution in workflow gates and LLM config
propositions: Three separate code paths pick the verifier model but silently fall back to the framework default when a non-default provider is configured, causing Pass-2 determinism to be lost and the downgrade to stop applying

Code-review.yaml's verify step declares no model key and carries temperature: 0 for greedy Pass-2 verification, but the setting never takes effect because the step runs on the frontier model instead of the standard class

resolve_model must resolve reserved class names (trivial/standard/frontier) through resolve_model_string to enable workflow steps to declare model: standard and defer to operator class configuration rather than hardcoding explicit model ids

The verifier paths (_verifier_cfg, _verifier_model_for_completion, code-review verify step) must all resolve the standard class regardless of cfg.model value, including when cfg.model is a provider-qualified Bedrock id or direct-Anthropic model
